chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who forgets to begin the prayer until he has bowed (in ruku'), he said, 'He must repeat the prayer.'

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abu Al-Hasan (Imam Al-Reza, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person forgets to start their prayer properly and goes straight to bowing?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Ali ibn Yaqtin asks Imam al-Rida (AS) about a specific error in prayer structure: forgetting the opening Takbir or initial standing and proceeding directly to ruku'. The Imam’s ruling of 'repeating the prayer' (i'ad) underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the opening Takbir is a fundamental pillar (rukn) or essential condition for validity, such that its omission invalidates the entire act of worship. This highlights the precision required in Shia fiqh regarding the sequence and essential components of Salah.
